arcs.alreadyResolvedNote: If the bay-steps snatch was witnessed and the Pupbble returned, this arc is already resolved — the Fisher's thanks are the whole of it, and no second deed is ever written for the same return.

lines: You didn't see a runner, did you? Grey hood, fast feet?
He took my Pupbble right off the bay steps. Forty years I've fished this harbour. She's been beside me for nine of them.
They say he makes camp in the tall grass on Route 1. If you're headed that way... that's all. That's everything I have to ask with.
stages.summary: The Dock Fisher's partner Pupbble was taken by a runner in a grey hood — if you didn't see it happen, he'll tell you himself, holding a lead with nothing on the end of it.
The runner's camp in the east tall grass, south of the cross path — trampled grass, a cold fire, a grey hood on a line.
Beat the runner at his camp. The Pupbble is in a crate by the fire, unhurt and furious.

lines: Nine years, and I never once held that lead tighter. I will now. I swear it on the harbour.
Whatever this town owes you, it starts with me. Thank you.
stages.summary: Bring the Pupbble back to the bay steps.

arcs.title: The Fisher's Empty Lead

lines: Mind the pack, it bruises. ...Sorry. I'm not usually short with strangers.
My Kittember slipped her lead on Route 1, two dusks past. She won't come to a shout — she comes to the smell of the pack at dusk, when her flame burns low.
West grass, south of the cross path. If you're there at dusk and you see a little flame that won't come closer... just be still. She'll decide.
stages.summary: A travelling herbalist stopped in Silicon Town because her Kittember slipped its lead on Route 1 at dusk and hasn't come back to the smell of her pack.
The west tall grass at dusk. A low tail-flame in the grass, keeping its distance — until it doesn't.

lines: There she is. There she— low flame and all. You were still, weren't you. She only comes to people who are still.
Nine roads we've walked. This is the first town she ever left me in, and the first stranger who ever brought her back.
Take the long way through dusk sometimes, Ranger. Everything true travels at that hour.
stages.summary: Walk the Kittember back to the MochiiPlex steps.

outcomes.label: You ran the thief down and won the Pupbble back.
The runner slipped you and vanished toward Route 1.
You kept walking. The shouting faded behind you.
You stepped into the Fisher's path — just long enough.

scene: A runner in a grey hood bursts off the bay steps with a Pupbble squirming under one arm!
The Dock Fisher is shouting himself hoarse. The whole shore can see it.
events.title: Snatch at the Bay Steps

outcomes.label: You called it out and beat the cheat fairly. The Razorgater went home with its real partner.
The cheat's borrowed strength was too much. The crowd drifted away, unsure what it saw.
You told the crowd there was nothing to see. The cheat nodded at you like a colleague.
Not your duel. You left them to it.

scene: Two Rangers are duelling right in the middle of the street — a crowd is gathering.
But watch the loser's Razorgater. It keeps crying back toward the OTHER Ranger. That creature isn't his.
events.title: A Duel That Isn't One

outcomes.label: You calmed it down and carried it back to the Field Hand.
You rushed at it — and it bolted straight back into the deep grass.
Nobody was holding the lead. So you did. Permanently.

scene: A Pupbble bursts out of the tall grass onto Main Street, terrified and tangling its own lead!
The Field Hand is calling for it from the path. Half the street is watching.
events.title: A Stray on Main Street

outcomes.label: You cut the runner off at the street corner and gave the case back in front of everyone.
You chased — and lost them between the buildings.
Somebody else's emergency. You went about your day.

scene: Right on the MochiiPlex steps — a grab-and-run! That was a whole case of Luigi Cubes!
The shopper is frozen. The runner is fast. You are closer.
events.title: The Plex Steps Grab

note: World-encounter placements for the living-world director (src/lib/livingWorld.ts). Grammar: Red Dead / GTA world encounters in the Pokemon world — witnessed events, stranger side-stories found in the world (never on a quest board), ambient life. Every deed id below is a row of the honor deed table (closed vocabulary — the director validates at load and refuses unknown deeds). Places carry a placeClass; the dark-forest class is FORBIDDEN by construction (Refusal law: absence there is authored) and this file deliberately contains no binary_woods placement — the director additionally refuses any that ever appears. Charge values are UNMARKED for every area here: neither Boot Harbor nor Silicon Town has an owner-ruled charge, and unruled places build UNMARKED (Game Bible S1). Personal names for the new townsfolk are OWNER SLOTS — placed NPCs carry role names, the pattern the maps already use (Technology Enthusiast, Dockhand Juno's role half). Cooldowns are in world beats (the honor ledger's beat unit, supplied by the caller until the world-clock module lands).
